_comment: Demo profile for the landing page's 'what comes out' asset ONLY. Not a harness fixture (harness/fixtures/profile.json is smaller and must stay that way — the campaign tests read it). Invented person, invented employers: the caption on the page says so. What is NOT invented is the artifact — site/demo/render.mjs renders this through the real tailor template and refuses to emit unless the PDF clears the product's own machine gate (exactly one page, content reaching >= 93% down it). A marketing asset that the product itself would reject is worse than no asset.
name: Jordan Avery
title: Software Engineer

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science; GPA: 3.79/4.00

description.text: Rebuilt the ingestion pipeline on Kafka and Go, lifting sustained throughput from 40k to 180k events per second while cutting p99 write latency by 62%.
Split a 90k-line Django monolith into four gRPC services behind a schema registry, shipping the migration in staged cutovers with zero customer-visible downtime.
Introduced OpenTelemetry tracing across 14 services and cut median incident triage time from 45 minutes to 9 by making cross-service latency attributable.
Replaced nightly batch rollups with incremental materialized views in PostgreSQL, reducing warehouse spend by $18k per month.
Owned the on-call rotation's reliability work for two quarters, driving error budget burn from 210% to 34% of the monthly allowance.
Built a Terraform module library that reduced new-service provisioning from a two-day manual checklist to a 15-minute templated pull request.
Instrumented the deploy pipeline with Prometheus metrics, surfacing a cache misconfiguration that had been adding 300ms to every authenticated request.
Wrote the load-test harness that became the release gate, catching a connection-pool regression that would have degraded checkout for 8% of sessions.
Documented the provisioning path and paired with three engineers on their first service, removing the platform team as a bottleneck for new work.
Built driftwood, an embedded change-data-capture engine that streams SQLite writes to any sink; 1.2k GitHub stars and 40k monthly crates.io downloads.
Compiled the core to WebAssembly so the same replication logic runs in the browser, in a Cloudflare Worker, and on a Raspberry Pi from one codebase.
Held replication lag under 50ms at 20k writes per second by batching on a lock-free ring buffer instead of a mutex-guarded queue.
Developed paperweight, a self-hosted document search service indexing 400k PDFs with hybrid keyword and vector retrieval.
Cut cold-start query time from 2.4s to 180ms by moving embeddings into pgvector with an IVFFlat index tuned against a labelled relevance set.
Shipped an offline-first Electron client so the same index is searchable on a laptop with no network, syncing deltas on reconnect.
